name: Tuning Tablet
environment_theme: A dry Spirit World fault basin cut by exposed celadon ley veins. Pale mineral silt and charcoal basalt frame narrow jade-lit fissures; stone chips hover just above some seams, and clear water trickles uphill into still pools. Bronze survey markers and small way shrines stabilize routes. No bamboo forest, swamp, coast, mountain skyline, cloud island, or technological circuitry.
brief: A single flat dark-stone tuning tablet with three simple bronze resonance grooves and one pale celadon inset. Overhead readable face, clean silhouette, transparent surroundings, no text or runes.
